title: How to Backdoor Image Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2504.21323v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student. It is often assumed to be safe when the teacher is clean, because classic backdoor attacks rely on poisoned labels and triggers in supervised training, whereas distillation trains the student to match a teacher's outputs. We show that this assumption can fail when the distillation dataset itself is poisoned. Our attack injects triggered and manipulated images that a clean teacher already predicts as an attacker chosen target label, which causes the student to learn a backdoor even though the teacher remains unaffected. We evaluate this threat across multiple manipulation strategies, including targeted adversarial perturbations and targeted GAN based class transitions, and study how distillation settings influence both accuracy and attack success. We show that the attack remains effective even at a 10% poisoning rates. The

translated_title: 如何对图像知识蒸馏进行后门攻击
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏被广泛用于将大型教师模型的行为迁移到较小的学生模型。当教师模型是干净的时，知识蒸馏通常被认为是安全的，因为经典的后门攻击依赖于监督训练中的中毒标签和触发器，而蒸馏则是训练学生模型去匹配教师模型的输出。我们表明，当蒸馏数据集本身被投毒时，这一假设可能会失效。我们的攻击注入带有触发器且经过操纵的图像，这些图像会被干净的教师模型预测为攻击者选定的目标标签，从而使学生在教师模型不受影响的情况下学到后门。我们在多种操纵策略下评估了这一威胁，包括针对性的对抗扰动和基于GAN的针对性类别转换，并研究了蒸馏设置如何同时影响准确率和攻击成功率。我们表明，即使在10%的中毒率下，该攻击仍然有效。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对图像知识蒸馏的新型后门攻击方法，通过向蒸馏数据集注入被干净教师模型预测为目标标签的触发图像，使学生在教师保持干净的情况下学到后门，且在10%中毒率下仍然有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel backdoor attack on image knowledge distillation by injecting triggered images that a clean teacher already predicts as the attacker's target label, causing the student to learn a backdoor while the teacher remains unaffected, remaining effective even at a 10% poisoning rate.
